title: Distributed Task Processing with Celery & Redis (PYTH_194_S1 to PYTH_194_S8)

slides.title: Asynchronous Task Queues
slides.prompt: Celery offloads long-running tasks to background worker processes using message brokers like Redis or RabbitMQ.

slides.title: Celery Task Decorator
slides.prompt: Fill in the decorator used to turn standard Python functions into asynchronous Celery tasks.

slides.title: Invoking Tasks Asynchronously
slides.prompt: Which method is used to send a task to the Celery queue for asynchronous execution by a worker?

slides.title: Retrieving Task Results
slides.prompt: Fill in the class imported from Celery to check and retrieve output status from asynchronous tasks.

slides.title: Celery Workflows (Chains and Groups)
slides.prompt: What is the difference between a `chain` and a `group` primitive in Celery workflow composition?
options: A chain executes tasks sequentially passing results forward, while a group executes tasks in parallel
A chain runs tasks on local threads, while a group runs tasks on remote Kubernetes nodes
A group executes tasks sequentially, while a chain discards failed task outputs
A chain requires Redis, while a group requires PostgreSQL
slides.correctAnswer: A chain executes tasks sequentially passing results forward, while a group executes tasks in parallel

slides.title: Celery Beat Periodic Scheduling
slides.prompt: Fill in the Celery extension component name used to run periodic scheduled cron-like jobs.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Run periodic tasks
celery -A proj ___ -l info

slides.title: Dead Letter Queues (DLQ)
slides.prompt: Why are Dead Letter Queues configured in background task processing systems?
options: To isolate and capture failed tasks that exceeded retry limits for inspection without blocking worker queues
To speed up the execution speed of successful tasks
To store temporary cache keys during database backup operations
To compress historical task logs into zip archives
slides.correctAnswer: To isolate and capture failed tasks that exceeded retry limits for inspection without blocking worker queues

slides.title: Task Auto-Retry Configuration
slides.prompt: Fill in the decorator argument used to specify maximum retry attempts upon task failure.
